2026-09-25PSPCNational Capital ActOrder Authorizing the National Capital Commission to Grant an Easement to the City of Ottawa (the City) ***NCC***Order authorizing the National Capital Commission to Grant an Easement for a period of 99 years to the City of Ottawa over part of the real property located at 492A Queen Elizabeth Drive, in Ottawa, Ontario, for the purpose of operation, inspection, repair, maintenance, and, if necessary, construction and replacement of municipal sewer infrastructure.N/A
subject: Order Authorizing the National Capital Commission to Grant an Easement to the City of Ottawa (the City) ***NCC***
precis: Order authorizing the National Capital Commission to Grant an Easement for a period of 99 years to the City of Ottawa over part of the real property located at 492A Queen Elizabeth Drive, in Ottawa, Ontario, for the purpose of operation, inspection, repair, maintenance, and, if necessary, construction and replacement of municipal sewer infrastructure.
